request_without_reference_paths.prompt: Create ONE original standalone asset for the SAME knowledge-city strategy-game civilization as the supplied Memory Archive image. Use the image as a strict material and architectural craftsmanship reference, NOT as a silhouette to copy. Warm pale limestone as the main matte mass, broad dark slate ceramic roofs, aged copper-bronze structural eaves and frames with contained turquoise patina, subtle warm amber only in shallow window panes or a tiny lantern. Large calm material regions, warm handcrafted stylized finish, sophisticated proportions rather than medieval fantasy or photorealism. City Forum: a stepped axial reading hall, NOT a church. A raised limestone podium terrace, a rectangular lecture volume, and a stepped gable of closed slate — no spire, no bell, no cross, no rose window, no stained-glass tracery, no religious iconography. A short flight of thick integrated steps leads to a deep rectangular doorway. Windows only as simple shallow framed rectangular recessed panels with thick frames, never perforations. Compact architectural base with no surrounding terrain hex. Read clearly as a civic forum / aula of reading, not a dwelling, guild, citadel, temple or observatory. Show the complete standalone subject in one clearly ELEVATED THREE-QUARTER ISOMETRIC view, with both front and side visible, all edges inside frame, neutral background and transparent cutout. Readable at small strategy-map scale. All walls and roofs 100% closed except the intended doorway recess. Thick connected structural pieces, no thin railings or filigree, no text, logos, people, gears, dramatic baked shadows, excessive grime, floating pieces or surrounding scenery.
